name: Inhaling Seagull
look: Four stacked frames of a white seagull perched on a green awning. It stands calmly, then tilts its head back to take a breath, then rears back even further, and in the last frame, tinted bright red, it screams with its beak wide open.
use: The first three frames build up slowly, as if drawing a long breath, and the fourth red frame delivers the loud, explosive punchline, usually a word or phrase being screamed.
examples: Me at the store spotting a dog
describe: seagull taking a deep breath then screaming
bird breathing in step by step then yelling in a red flash
four panel gull leaning back before a loud scream
white bird rears back and shrieks with a red background
